title: Origin story: Sablewing
description: Sablewing was a rookery keeper's daughter who learned the ravens' speech, and when the wars came, she became their general: a flock of ten thousand black wings carrying messages no enemy could intercept. She flies with them still, in raven form when she chooses, the night's own courier.
